name: Colt Fitzgerald
source:
Colt is [url=/c148364]Blaine[/url]’s father. The founder of Sin Parade, formerly a porn magazine before the internet age. Sin Parade was bought and rebranded by another company, giving Colt a headstart into what he actually wanted to do.
